svg.aria-label: Five projects by Harkirat Singh Saggar

g.text: 01 / VALENS
Autonomous cyber-deception platform for real-time MITRE ATT&CK correlation.
Deploys canary tokens, automated WAF quarantine, and RAG-powered incident response.
PYTHON · FASTAPI · MITRE ATT&CK · WEBSOCKETS · CYBERSECURITY
02 / DECODE NEURAL NETWORKS
Neural-network fundamentals explored from first principles.
Implements core forward and learning concepts while studying the math.
PYTHON · NUMPY · TENSORFLOW · NEURAL NETWORKS
03 / HYPERPARAMETER TUNING
Keras Tuner experiments for searching neural-network hyperparameters.
Compares candidate configurations to improve validation performance.
PYTHON · TENSORFLOW · KERAS TUNER · JUPYTER
04 / WEIGHTS INITIALIZATION
Experiments with neural-network weight initialization and training behavior.
Explores how initialization affects convergence and learned representations.
PYTHON · TENSORFLOW · KERAS · DEEP LEARNING
05 / IMPROVING NEURAL NETWORKS
Experiments with dropout, regularization and training improvements.
Studies practical techniques for reducing overfitting and improving generalization.
PYTHON · TENSORFLOW · KERAS · REGULARIZATION
